goal: One frozen, prospective source-free falsification: does choosing interventions that discriminate between hypotheses with different optimal causal decisions beat both the existing native transition-variance exploration and a deterministic random policy, while preserving the same cumulative native 448-event source prefix, 128 observed actions per arm, and exact cold retention?
training_policy: One out of four episodes exploits via unchanged native context_plan, as CKAD27. Otherwise the decision candidate selects first action with greatest native-posterior expected value of perfect second-action information across observed next states; second action selects maximum (decision-discordant posterior predictive variance minus immediate mixture reward regret). Non-positive scores cause the mixture-best second action, and first-action ties fall back to native exploration. Neither hidden phase nor unseen action consequence is inspected. Native and deterministic random controls share source exogenous keys, action opportunities and held outcomes.
matched_controls: fully fitted conventional trailing-window MLE control per arm, trained on identical revealed public actions and outcomes
independent exact source witness history and cold native model replay

held_evaluations.per_checkpoint_world: The world at count=0 is first phase; at count 32,64,96,128 use the just-completed phase index (count-1)//32 to evaluate retention of the learned world without using results for model update.
metrics: mean reward of the learned native context_plan on 96 new matched held episodes per arm/seed/checkpoint
transition and terminal Brier score of native context_forecast over independent deterministic fixed interventions on same held episodes
fully trained conventional fitted MLE plan score from the arm's public witnesses, separately audited
first/second action balance and directed policy dissimilarity from native
cold checkpoint exact SHA and original prefix bytes

frozen_gates.reward_change_gain_vs_native: Candidate held terminal reward across counts64,96,128 exceeds native by >=0.05 absolute.
frozen_gates.reward_change_gain_vs_random: Candidate held terminal reward across counts64,96,128 exceeds random by >=0.05 absolute.
frozen_gates.reward_change_per_seed: Candidate strictly exceeds native for >=2/3 independent original pretrained seed groups.
frozen_gates.reward_prediction_quality: Candidate terminal Brier score at least 0.01 lower than native across same held cohorts.
frozen_gates.stationary_no_harm: Candidate stationary_null held reward no more than 0.03 below native.
frozen_gates.familiar_return: At reward_change count96 candidate held reward no more than 0.03 below native.
frozen_gates.strong_conventional: Candidate native held reward >= its own fully fitted matched-receipt conventional trailing-window MLE.
frozen_gates.source_integrity: Linux and Windows source and cold native exact parity; each source arm retains 448 original witnesses and adds 128 novel public interventions; zero held training updates or protected source first-use.

promotion: One frozen primary pass only. DEVELOPMENT_GO only if all preregistered gates pass; otherwise NO_GO and stop this candidate. Engineering qualification does not prove superior causal reasoning or general intelligence. Strong exact Bayesian-mixture parity remains an explicit limitation.
isolation: Native Yggdrasil model, model contracts, accepted main, CKAD27 frozen evidence and protected original cohorts unchanged; one contributor branch only, no new controller/scheduler, acceptance, merge, promotion or deployment.
decision_relevance: Exact rational Fraction computations. First action: sum over prospective next states P(state|intervention) * [sum over native models weight * max(second-action reward forecast) - max(second action mixture forecast)]. Second action: for each candidate second action compute posterior variance contributed by models whose optimal action disagrees with the mixture-optimal action, minus immediate mixture-regret of that action; choose larger strictly positive score, else choose mixture-optimal. Opposing-model ties are counted as agreeing; all ties resolved deterministically. Do not retune weights, threshold, seeds, test family or budgets after seeing results.
